quotes.name: Ore Gorger
quotes.flavor:
"We've stumbled upon a network of caves not on our maps. We can only hope it is safe to spend the night."
—Lost Battalion, message to General Takeno

quotes.name: Mad Auntie
quotes.flavor: One part cunning, one part wise, and many, many parts demented.

quotes.name: Summit Apes
quotes.flavor:
"If you climb Skyfang Peak, avoid the pass. Generations of apes made that trail, and they don't tolerate trespassers."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Parasitic Strix
quotes.flavor: Tras no encontrar sustento en los bordes de Grixis, se volvió hacia los cielos de Bant.

quotes.name: Boros Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"It is our duty to protect all those in need. But the other guilds have never shown themselves worthy of that protection."
—Tajic

quotes.name: City of Brass
quotes.flavor:
"There is much to learn here, but few can endure the ringing of the spires."
—Nulakam the Archivist

quotes.name: Craw Wurm
quotes.flavor: The most terrifying thing about the Craw Wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

quotes.name: Ivy Lane Denizen
quotes.flavor: "Skyknight gear? Well, I have drake-skin gauntlets, supple and fireproof. Or a ceratok chestplate that'll stop a crossbow bolt."

quotes.name: Spectral Procession
quotes.flavor:
"The dead have it easy. They suffer no more. If breaking their rest helps the living, so be it."
—Olka, mistmeadow witch

quotes.name: Jackdaw Savior
quotes.flavor:
Be the calm in the storm.
—Birdfolk saying

quotes.name: Boomerang
quotes.flavor:
"O! call back yesterday, bid time return."
—William Shakespeare,
*King Richard the Second*

quotes.name: Growth Spiral
quotes.flavor: Hidden within the infinite, protean rooms of the House are strange pockets of power that only the bravest dare access.

quotes.name: Defend the Hearth
quotes.flavor: The defenders said not a word. Their shields, spears, and stances were warning enough.

quotes.name: Peerless Ropemaster
quotes.flavor: "Murder someone and you'll have a gaggle of folks lining up for revenge. Humiliate them, and they won't dare bother you again."

quotes.name: Grizzly Bears
quotes.flavor: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

quotes.name: Genesis Ultimatum
quotes.flavor: No human eyes have ever witnessed the birth of an apex monster.

quotes.name: Jhovall Rider
quotes.flavor: Don't be fooled by the riders' fluid grace—it takes years of practice to ride these beasts.

quotes.name: Dimir Signet
quotes.flavor: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

quotes.name: Avalanche
quotes.flavor:
"The pass was completely blocked by the avalanche; we're forced to turn back. Nevertheless, we've gone farther and seen more than any before us."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

quotes.name: Blood Vassal
quotes.flavor:
"They are bred to suffer and born to die. Much like humans."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

quotes.name: Swelter
quotes.flavor: No circle has a beginning, but many have foreseeable ends.

quotes.name: Boil
quotes.flavor: "When every reef is bared and every wave is dust—only then shall I rest."

quotes.name: Wind Dancer
quotes.flavor: The sky is her stage.

quotes.name: Prodigal Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: He wastes his amazing talents on proving how amazing he really is.

quotes.name: High Tide
quotes.flavor: "There's nothing like the high seas to clear your head or escape pursuers."

quotes.name: Encroaching Mycosynth
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor:
"Careful—however they might look, they're not human. A step too close and they'll drag you in."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: The Conflux crashed together far-flung continents, like ships colliding in a storm.

quotes.name: Fury Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"A rift opened, and our arrows were abruptly stilled. To move was to push the world. But the sliver's claw still twitched, red wounds appeared in Thed's chest, and ribbons of blood hung in the air."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish hero

quotes.name: Well Rested
quotes.flavor: When you're a deep sleeper, any bed will do.

quotes.name: Stupefying Touch
quotes.flavor: Just because your eyes are open doesn't mean you're awake.

quotes.name: Goblin Tunneler
quotes.flavor: "The best way over the mountain is through."

quotes.name: Wash Out
quotes.flavor:
"It's not the darkness I fear but dull and numbing shades of gray."
—Sydri, galvanic genius

quotes.name: Plague Beetle
quotes.flavor: No one knows whether they were named for the disease they carry or for the speed at which they multiply.

quotes.name: Waterlogged Grove
quotes.flavor:
"Beware the Sphere. Beware Skagra. Beware Shada."
—Professor Chronotis

quotes.name: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds
quotes.flavor: "You're living on borrowed time."

quotes.name: Disenchant
quotes.flavor:
The scepter of power is fragile in a calloused hand.
—Cho-Arrim saying

quotes.name: Anthem of Champions
quotes.flavor: Setessa is protected by four warrior factions, each named for an animal. United, they can repel any threat to their polis.

quotes.name: Waiting in the Weeds
quotes.flavor: The trees have ears, eyes, and teeth.

quotes.name: Raging Swordtooth
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: Carnivorous dinosaurs developed a taste for undead flesh, tracking the vampires by the scent of blood on their breath.

quotes.name: Circuitous Route
quotes.flavor:
"The shortest path between two points is not always the safest."
—Tamina, district guide

quotes.name: Sacred Foundry
quotes.flavor:
"Log 2.2.119: Kiln, known for its blazing forges and ancient lava seeps. The footing may be treacherous, but the metallurgy is grand!"
—*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*

quotes.name: Sengir Vampire
quotes.flavor: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

quotes.name: Sugar Coat
quotes.flavor: Some jokes have the punchline baked in.

quotes.name: Kelsien, the Plague
quotes.flavor: "Aim for an eye. Better they never see you."

quotes.name: Academy Manufactor
quotes.flavor: Automated systems at the Tolarian Academy sort new acquisitions for optimal use, determining which should be studied, eaten, or sold.

quotes.name: Eye of Ojer Taq // Apex Observatory
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: Though they had never left the Core, the Oltec knew the stars.

quotes.name: Jumbo Cactuar
quotes.flavor: Some Cactuars live long lives and grow huge. This Jumbo Cactuar is one of them.

quotes.name: Null Group Biological Assets
quotes.flavor:
"I'm a company woman. I'm part of the plan. I'm part of the team. And I enjoy my work."
—Zodi

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

quotes.name: Rootha, Mastering the Moment
quotes.flavor: "The great thrill of perfection is that we'll always be chasing it."

quotes.name: Elvish Archdruid
quotes.flavor: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

quotes.name: Megrim
quotes.flavor: Memories cut from the mind can cut right back.

quotes.name: Sarkhan's Rage
quotes.flavor: The people of Tarkir speak of an ancient legend, of the dragon-man called Sarkhan who was greatest of all khans.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor:
When winter first begins to bite
and stones crack in the frosty night,
when pools are black and trees are bare,
'tis evil in the Wild to fare.

quotes.name: Morbid Opportunist
quotes.flavor: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

quotes.name: Yargle and Multani
quotes.flavor:
"I tried to think of the most harmless thing . . . something I loved from my childhood," Stantz mumbled. "Something that could never, ever possibly destroy us. Mr. Stay Puft!"
"Nice thinkin', Ray," replied Venkman.

quotes.name: Squee, the Immortal
quotes.flavor:
Squee had never wanted to be a king or a symbol of defiance against Phyrexians. Naturally, he found himself as both.
—*Heroes of the Second Invasion*

quotes.name: Evolutionary Escalation
quotes.flavor: Survival is a constant competition from which both sides can benefit.

quotes.name: Raise the Past
quotes.flavor: At Strixhaven University, learning about the past means talking to those who were there.

quotes.name: Glorious Anthem
quotes.flavor: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.

quotes.name: Will of the All-Hunter
quotes.flavor:
"It's Snapdax. You'd have a better chance of breaching a wall with a slice of bread."
—Krek, daysquad captain

quotes.name: Bane of Progress
quotes.flavor: Urza's forces tore across Argoth, and Argoth responded in kind.

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Stoneforge Masterwork
quotes.flavor: The nomadic kor carry only necessities on their long treks. The coming of the Eldrazi redefined "necessities."

quotes.name: Kataki, War's Wage
quotes.flavor:
"Before the war, we prayed to Kataki to sharpen our swords and harden our armor. Without his blessing our weapons are all but useless against the kami hordes."
—Kenzo the Hardhearted

quotes.name: Grinning Ignus
quotes.flavor:
"Take care what you offer the ignus. Food, perhaps. Coins. But nothing flammable!"
—Stovic, village eccentric

quotes.name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
quotes.flavor: He has journeyed where none have been before. Now he returns to ensure that none follow.

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

quotes.name: Sacred Knight
quotes.flavor: "No flame, no horror can sway me from my cause."

quotes.name: Prompto Argentum
quotes.flavor: "Look out world, here we come!"

quotes.name: Curse of Opulence
quotes.flavor: Jingling coins beckon many an eager hand.

quotes.name: Rally to Battle
quotes.flavor: The guildmasters loom large in the political sphere, but in the end, the rulers of Ravnica are its people.

quotes.name: Slaying Fire
quotes.flavor: The purest virtue burns brighter than the sun and hotter than dragonfire.

quotes.name: Ghoulsteed
quotes.flavor: It once served a cathar roadwatcher, patrolling the crossways between villages. Its hooves still carry it along the same path.

quotes.name: Dissatisfied Customer
quotes.flavor: The mirrors weren't fun for everyone.

quotes.name: Ironclaw Orcs
quotes.flavor: Generations of genetic weeding have given rise to the deviously cowardly Ironclaw clan. To say that Orcs in general are vicious, depraved, and ignoble does not do justice to the Ironclaw.

quotes.name: Wickerbough Elder
quotes.flavor: "Living scarecrows make a mockery of the natural order. Dead ones make fine hats."

quotes.name: Trumpet Blast
quotes.flavor: Keldon warriors don't need signals to tell them when to attack. They need signals to tell them when to stop.

quotes.name: Blessing
quotes.flavor:
"Virtue can't survive without strength."
—Ardanna of the Angelic Council

quotes.name: Thrashing Brontodon
quotes.flavor: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

quotes.name: Opt
quotes.flavor: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's planeswalker spark. Had Jhoira given him a blessing or a curse?

quotes.name: Kapsho Kitefins
quotes.flavor:
"It's a truly disconcerting sight to see their shadows cast upon the deck."
—Captain Triff

quotes.name: Heroes' Bane
quotes.flavor: Travelers' tales claim that hydras bite off their own heads to make themselves deadlier.

quotes.name: Pacifism
quotes.flavor: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

quotes.name: Lotleth Giant
quotes.flavor:
"I prefer the big and looming to the small and skittering."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

quotes.name: Meriadoc Brandybuck
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "My dear old Hobbit, you don't allow for the inquisitiveness of friends. I have known about the existence of the Ring for years."

quotes.name: Jetmir's Garden
quotes.flavor: The parklike Cabaretti grounds offer rest, food, and the perfect place to shake off a tail.

quotes.name: Storm God's Oracle
quotes.flavor: The lives of Keranos's chosen are brief and brilliant as lightning.

quotes.name: Karplusan Forest
quotes.flavor: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

quotes.name: Oketra's Last Mercy
quotes.flavor: To the end, all Oketra did was for others.

quotes.name: Dead Weight
quotes.flavor:
"Dungeons and cages offer far too little sport."
—Relio Voldaren

quotes.name: Celestial Flare
quotes.flavor:
"You were defeated the moment you declared your aggression."
—Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Mana Cylix
quotes.flavor: Overflowing with visions of the possible future, it lends power to those in the present.

quotes.name: Mesa Pegasus
quotes.flavor: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

quotes.name: Temple of Plenty
quotes.flavor: Pre-owned, pre-rusted, pre-irradiated.

quotes.name: Avatar of Discord
quotes.flavor: Such is the power of Rakdos that even his shadow takes on a cruel life of its own.

quotes.name: Depart the Realm
quotes.flavor: "My home calls to me, I must go."

quotes.name: Prodigal Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: Occasionally a member of the Institute of Arcane Study acquires a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

quotes.name: Tome Scour
quotes.flavor: La genialidad está sobreestimada, especialmente la ajena.

quotes.name: Emeria Angel
quotes.flavor: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

quotes.name: Reveille Squad
quotes.flavor: "To arms! To arms! The Lion roars!"

quotes.name: Ivory Tower
quotes.flavor: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

quotes.name: Arvad the Cursed
quotes.flavor: "I won't abandon the *Weatherlight*. My destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side. This 'illness' means I must trust my faith more and myself less."

quotes.name: Phantasmal Dragon
quotes.flavor: 嘘と霧から生み出されたものにも関わらず、その飢えと怒りは力を持つ。

quotes.name: Bulk Up
quotes.flavor:
"My teeth to bite and break, my claws to rip and rend, my heart with fury quakes, to madness I ascend."
—*Kathorran War Chants, vol. 1*

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Sunrise Sovereign
quotes.flavor: A hundred generations has he mentored, a hundred armies has he crushed beneath his feet, yet only a hundred words has he ever spoken, each more revered than a hundred books.

quotes.name: Inspiring Paladin
quotes.flavor: As the line faltered, the thunder of hoofbeats heralded desperately needed aid.

quotes.name: Plains
quotes.flavor: You've heard rumors of bandits along the Coast Way, but your journey so far has even surprisingly uneventful.

quotes.name: Desert Twister
quotes.flavor: The magical dust clouds Mercadian mages use to traverse the plane generate storms that devastate the surrounding terrain. But as long as the storms don't touch the mountain, the nobles simply don't care.

quotes.name: Changeling Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: No map. No complaints.

quotes.name: Mournful Zombie
quotes.flavor: Treated with a powerful mix of herbs and potions, its wrappings have a remarkable preservative effect, even for the living.

quotes.name: Inspiring Call
quotes.flavor: "Noo-lahs tah dah ay-loh."

quotes.name: Weldfast Wingsmith
quotes.flavor: "Airships are too confining. If I'm in the sky, I want to feel the wind in my hair and taste the aether."

quotes.name: Anaba Shaman
quotes.flavor: Just try taking *this* bull by the horns.

quotes.name: Demon's Disciple
quotes.flavor: Taborax's cultists are the latest in a long history of beings who have desired to see Zendikar torn to pieces.

quotes.name: Keldon Raider
quotes.flavor: Keldon raiders' spoils are limited to what their colos can carry. No matter the value, the rest goes up in smoke.

quotes.name: Windrider Wizard
quotes.flavor: "It's an ideal method for exploring sky ruins. The drakes sniff me briefly but then lose interest."

quotes.name: Youthful Knight
quotes.flavor: Idealism fits him better than his armor.

quotes.name: Body Double
quotes.flavor: "I am who I pretend to be."

quotes.name: Cathar Commando
quotes.flavor: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."

quotes.name: Worthy Knight
quotes.flavor: Every Ardenvale aspirant must step through the flame. Their honor determines whether they burn or shine.

quotes.name: Talisman of Impulse
quotes.flavor:
"Act as if you know their plan, and sometimes, if you're very lucky, they'll actually tell you it!"
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Lord of the Undead
quotes.flavor:
"I confer with Death itself. What could you possibly do to injure me?"
—Lord Dralnu

quotes.name: Dancing Scimitar
quotes.flavor: Bobbing merrily from opponent to opponent, the scimitar began adding playful little flourishes to its strokes; it even turned a couple of somersaults.

quotes.name: Spectacular Spider-Man
quotes.flavor: "Have no fear. Spidey is here!"

quotes.name: Treasure Nabber
quotes.flavor: The Law of Givesies Backsies is respected by every noble pursuer of shiny things.

quotes.name: Villagers of Estwald // Howlpack of Estwald
quotes.flavor: You can spot a werewolf-infested town by its lack of butcher shops.

quotes.name: Loxodon Warhammer
quotes.flavor:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira

quotes.name: Resolute Rider
quotes.flavor: "Respect the wilds? Certainly. Fear them? No."

quotes.name: Ruinous Ultimatum
quotes.flavor: "This little hamlet has too much 'boring' and not enough 'burning'... Torch everything!"

quotes.name: Uncomfortable Chill
quotes.flavor: The cold slowed their movements until only their panicked eyeballs swiveled beneath the ice.

quotes.name: Croaking Counterpart
quotes.flavor: Frog is the sincerest form of flattery.

quotes.name: Enduring Ideal
quotes.flavor: "I'm not cheating . . . I'm just adding new rules."

quotes.name: Quilled Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"They have long kept us under attack, but we do not lack for ammunition. The very bodies of our foes arm us against them."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish hero

quotes.name: Beregond of the Guard
quotes.flavor:
"Beregond, if you can, do something to stop any dreadful thing from happening."
—Pippin

quotes.name: Zndrsplt's Judgment
quotes.flavor: Zndrsplt retired from officiating when she teamed up with Okaun, but she still knows the penalties better than anyone else.

quotes.name: Nev, the Practical Dean
quotes.flavor: "Adrix and I have always debated for the betterment of our students. That won't change now we're both deans."

quotes.name: Battle Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"One emitted a strange series of buzzing clicks and guttural commands, then clawed arms emerged from all of them. Is there no limit to their adaptations?"
—Hastric, Thunian scout

quotes.name: Inspiring Unicorn
quotes.flavor: There are two lives: the life you live before you see a unicorn, and the life you live after.

quotes.name: Mana Crypt
quotes.flavor: Many of the ancient civilizations beneath Ixalan were destroyed by outside forces. Others tapped into power they found they could not control.

quotes.name: Seal Away
quotes.flavor: An ancient nemesis rendered harmless long ago.

quotes.name: Tawnos's Tinkering
quotes.flavor: While his master tried to surpass nature, Tawnos aimed to capture its beauty.

quotes.name: Frost Lynx
quotes.flavor: It readily attacks much larger prey, knowing retaliation is impossible.

quotes.name: Clay Statue
quotes.flavor: Tawnos won fame as Urza's greatest assistant. After he created these warriors, Urza ended his apprenticeship, promoting him directly to the rank of master.

quotes.name: Release the Gremlins
quotes.flavor:
"Being an inventor means knowing how to use the tools at hand to make something great—or to bring it down."
—Pia Nalaar

quotes.name: Aura of Dominion
quotes.flavor:
"Lies and deceit do yield results, but legitimate authority is the ultimate form of control."
—Meloku the Clouded Mirror

quotes.name: Command Beacon
quotes.flavor:
"I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest."
—Riku of Two Reflections

quotes.name: Knight of Meadowgrain
quotes.flavor: "By tradition, we don't speak for two days after battle. If our deeds won't speak for themselves, what else could be said?"

quotes.name: Crypt Creeper
quotes.flavor: To unearth its dinner, it inters itself.

quotes.name: Strength of the Harvest // Haven of the Harvest
quotes.flavor: The Kelema Veil flows through Setessa, allowing Karametra's faithful followers direct access to her wisdom and power.

quotes.name: Hermit of the Natterknolls // Lone Wolf of the Natterknolls
quotes.flavor: . . . but he'll have you for lunch.

quotes.name: Twin Bolt
quotes.flavor:
"Fire is only as precise as your control over it."
—Danfeng, Jeskai mage

quotes.name: Monoxa, Midway Manager
quotes.flavor: "Can we get this ghost 11% spookier?"

quotes.name: White Knight
quotes.flavor:
"When good men die their goodness does not perish, / But lives though they are gone."
—Euripides, *Termenidae*, trans. Morgan

quotes.name: Guttersnipe
quotes.flavor:
"I'm not sure we can outlast them, Captain. Their ammunition appears to be lava, Captain."
—Stubert, pirate gunner

quotes.name: Defiant Bloodlord
quotes.flavor:
"Despite their bravado, mortals are fragile. If Zendikar is to endure, its lords must save it."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

quotes.name: White Lotus Tile
quotes.flavor:
"Most people think the lotus tile insignificant, but it is essential for the unusual strategy that I employ."
—Iroh

quotes.name: Fyndhorn Druid
quotes.flavor:
"All struggles ultimately require sacrifice. It's just that some sacrifices are dearer than others."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

quotes.name: Pack Leader
quotes.flavor_name: 仲間を導くもの、ガルク
quotes.flavor: オトモガルクはハンターにとっては親友であり、モンスターにとってはひどい悪夢である。

quotes.name: Marketwatch Phantom
quotes.flavor: "It's amazing how efficient a detective you can be when you're not slowed down by things like self-preservation or walls."

quotes.name: Kruin Striker
quotes.flavor: Unhappy with the creation of the wolfir, Rorica broke with her order and led a crusade against the "reformed werewolves."

quotes.name: Gloomlake Verge
quotes.flavor: Here, the Floodpits languish like a corpse, the clear waters choked by the filthy hands of the bog.

quotes.name: Thought Vessel
quotes.flavor: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

quotes.name: Boros Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.

quotes.name: Runed Stalactite
quotes.flavor: When a changeling adopts a form no other changeling has taken, a rune appears in the caverns of Velis Vel to mark the event.

quotes.name: Mogg Fanatic
quotes.flavor:
"As if his chest had been a mortar, he burst his hot heart's shell upon it."
—Herman Melville, *Moby Dick*

quotes.name: Brushland
quotes.flavor:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Drown in Dreams
quotes.flavor:
"Within our minds are limitless depths. Dive down, but don't forget to surface."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Consulate Dreadnought
quotes.flavor:
"It's like they planted another Bastion right in the middle of the harbor."
—Bes Tavani, Bomat merchant

quotes.name: Dragonborn Champion
quotes.flavor: "Once I sought to be remembered by my people. Now I seek to rescue my people's memory."

quotes.name: Infectious Horror
quotes.flavor: Not once in the history of Grixis has anyone died of old age.

quotes.name: Hound of the Farbogs
quotes.flavor: As you hear it baying in the distance, you'll feel its breath on your neck.

quotes.name: Spectral Shield
quotes.flavor:
"What can be a stronger shield than concealment? Have you ever defeated an enemy you didn't know existed?"
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

quotes.name: Shatter
quotes.flavor: The ogre's mind snapped. The bow was next. The archer followed quickly after.

quotes.name: Boon-Bringer Valkyrie
quotes.flavor: Her blades were twin beacons, calling the worthy to glory and the wretched to despair.

quotes.name: Stormkeld Vanguard // Bear Down
quotes.flavor: He rides like thunder and strikes like lightning.

quotes.name: Commander Greven il-Vec
quotes.flavor:
"Rage is the only freedom left me."
—Greven *il*-Vec

quotes.name: Thriving Bluff
quotes.flavor: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

quotes.name: Wild Mongrel
quotes.flavor: It teaches *you* to play dead.

quotes.name: Vance's Blasting Cannons // Spitfire Bastion
quotes.flavor: Now instead of a ship, Ripley Vance commands a fortress.

quotes.name: Rowan, Scion of War
quotes.flavor: "No more days withering at a negotiating table with my brother. I will rebuild Eldraine myself—the old way, with power."

quotes.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
quotes.flavor: "I think you'll find my terms quite agreeable, if you know what's good for you."

quotes.name: Foul Orchard
quotes.flavor: The stench of rotting meat lures flies, goblins, and young raptors.

quotes.name: Cenn's Tactician
quotes.flavor: The choke point was the plan, but devoted camaraderie was always her strategy.

quotes.name: Unstable Obelisk
quotes.flavor: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

quotes.name: Boros Swiftblade
quotes.flavor: When the Boros Legion attacks, swiftblades enter the fray first. They pick off the archers and mages, softening the enemy front before the flame-kin and giants go in.

quotes.name: Cinder Barrens
quotes.flavor:
"Burn their fleet to the waterline, and sink whatever's left."
—Angrath

quotes.name: Skirk Prospector
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor:
"I like goblins. They make funny little popping sounds when they die."
—Braids, dementia summoner

quotes.name: Pentagram of the Ages
quotes.flavor: A mirror, a shield, a promise, a great distance, and a kind word—five ways to avoid harm.

quotes.name: Volcanic Spite
quotes.flavor: None may approach the Ashen Idol without an offering—an edict fortuitously absent from Phyrexian intelligence concerning the world of Azgol.

quotes.name: Ornithopter of Paradise
quotes.flavor:
"Through even our darkest days, we must never cease creating. Each new invention brings value to the world, be it beauty, utility, or both."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

quotes.name: Hellkite Igniter
quotes.flavor: Its flight sets the sky itself on fire.

quotes.name: Archelos, Lagoon Mystic
quotes.flavor: "Life ... is not ... a race."

quotes.name: Band Together
quotes.flavor: In times of peril, the vision the ancient paruns had for their city comes into focus.

quotes.name: Satyr Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

quotes.name: Burrenton Forge-Tender
quotes.flavor: "We are a clachan of smiths. The forge is as comfortable to us as a small fire during a cool winter's evening."

quotes.name: Rapid Rescue
quotes.flavor: Another day, another disaster.

quotes.name: Youthful Valkyrie
quotes.flavor: Before she is admitted to the host of Starnheim, a young valkyrie must learn a thousand tales of her ancestors.

quotes.name: Take Heart
quotes.flavor: In the quiet before a battle, Boros soldiers whisper prayers that steady their nerves and focus their minds.

quotes.name: Viridian Shaman
quotes.flavor: She stands as a living symbol of the natural world and an enemy of the forces that threaten it.

quotes.name: Sun Titan
quotes.flavor: A blazing sun that never sets.

quotes.name: Valakut Awakening // Valakut Stoneforge
quotes.flavor:
"I can hear the echo of their hammers, long stilled."
—Tars Olan, stoneforge mystic

quotes.name: Naturalize
quotes.flavor: The idols of old are rich in minerals and magic. They are torn apart when nature aims to eat well.

quotes.name: Fiery Cannonade
quotes.flavor: Wary of the ferocious dinosaurs, the Legion of Dusk built up the walls of their fort—just in time for the pirates to burn them down.

quotes.name: Sower of Chaos
quotes.flavor: After a few minutes in the cathar's attire, Vizrik started getting all kinds of new ideas.

quotes.name: Soltari Monk
quotes.flavor:
"Prayer rarely explains."
—Orim, Samite healer

quotes.name: Collector Ouphe
quotes.flavor:
"He steals power from treasure after treasure, and what does it do for the ouphe? Nothing."
—Jhoira

quotes.name: Squirrel Wrangler
quotes.flavor: "Acorns? Again?"

quotes.name: Body Count
quotes.flavor: "Your friends stayed quiet, and look what happened to them. You feeling a little more talkative yet?"

quotes.name: Merrow Wavebreakers
quotes.flavor: The merrows' prey have retreated from the shore, so they have learned to follow.

quotes.name: Where Ancients Tread
quotes.flavor:
"Never subtle nor cryptic is the reckoning of the mighty."
—Mayael the Anima

quotes.name: Uthden Troll
quotes.flavor:
"Oi oi oi, me gotta hurt in 'ere,
Oi oi oi, me smell a ting is near,
Gonna bosh 'n gonna nosh 'n da
hurt'll disappear."
—Traditional

quotes.name: Breaker of Armies
quotes.flavor:
"There are some who have lost everyone and everything. They actively seek out the Eldrazi, eager for the smallest measure of vengeance."
—Munda, ambush leader

quotes.name: Wildcall
quotes.flavor: A howl on the wind hides many dangers.

quotes.name: Intrepid Hero
quotes.flavor: "We each have our own strengths, Radiant," Serra said with a sly smile. "If all of my people were like this one, who would carry your scrolls?"

quotes.name: Inspired Tinkering
quotes.flavor: "What do you mean 'Does it work?' What an insulting question."

quotes.name: Inferno
quotes.flavor: "Any scrap of compassion that still existed in my soul was permanently snuffed out when they cast me out into the flames." —Mairsil, called the Pretender

quotes.name: Doran, the Siege Tower
quotes.flavor: "Each year that passes rings you inwardly with memory and might. Wield your heart, and the world will tremble."

quotes.name: Bloodrage Vampire
quotes.flavor: The most genteel facades hide the most abominable desires.

quotes.name: Soul's Fire
quotes.flavor: An avatar he sculpts of anger and flame.

quotes.name: Rotting Fensnake
quotes.flavor: Its venom sacs are long gone, but its crushing strength is somehow greater than ever.

quotes.name: Bogstomper
quotes.flavor:
"They are gentle herbivores, despite their size. Approach cautiously, and hum a tune to let them know you mean no harm."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Sanguine Evangelist
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Promos
quotes.flavor: "Fang-brethren, we feed together."

quotes.name: Shuri, the Black Panther
quotes.flavor: "Monster! You've faced the muscle of Wakanda. Now face its claws."

quotes.name: Sigarda, Host of Herons
quotes.flavor: Great devotion yields great reward.

quotes.name: Scavenging Ooze
quotes.flavor: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

quotes.name: Bog Wraith
quotes.flavor: The bodies of its victims are the only tracks it leaves.

quotes.name: Griffin Protector
quotes.flavor: The drums of war stir the hearts of all who fight for righteousness.

quotes.name: Bloodstained Mire
quotes.flavor: A graveyard for conquerors and conquered alike.

quotes.name: Swiftfoot Boots
quotes.flavor:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

quotes.name: Eager Glyphmage
quotes.flavor: Sharrel poured his heart into his words and watched them take flight.

quotes.name: Explosive Impact
quotes.flavor:
"Such boorish noise is what passes for subtlety among the Boros."
—Vraska

quotes.name: Command Decision
quotes.flavor:
"If we're going to be damned, let's be damned for what we really are."
—Captain Jean-Luc Picard

quotes.name: Honeymoon Hearse
quotes.flavor: A carriage crafted from the finest materials. Horses bred from the finest stock. Skulls taken from the finest foes.

quotes.name: Flesh Carver
quotes.flavor: "Just a taste?"

quotes.name: Necrogen Spellbomb
quotes.flavor:
"Forget that which was never known."
—Spellbomb inscription

quotes.name: Aurochs
quotes.flavor: One aurochs may feed a village, but a herd will flatten it.

quotes.name: Treasured Find
quotes.flavor: Gorgons crave beautiful things: gems, exquisite amulets, the alabaster corpses of the petrified dead . . .

quotes.name: Maro
quotes.flavor: No two draw the same Maro.

quotes.name: Essence Scatter
quotes.flavor:
"Phyrexians pollute everything they touch, so the solution is simple: don't let them touch anything."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Dictate of Erebos
quotes.flavor: "I take no pleasure in your suffering, but it is necessary. Once you accept your fate you'll find eternity more tolerable."

quotes.name: Goblin Chieftain
quotes.flavor: "We are goblinkind, heirs to the mountain empires of chieftains past. Rest is death to us, and arson is our call to war."

quotes.name: Hedron Rover
quotes.flavor:
"Now that it has woken up and wandered off, we should go see what it was guarding."
—Gotzen, Bulwark explorer

quotes.name: Cauldron of Essence
quotes.flavor: In the gloomy depths of Widdershins Hall sits an iron belly—always hungry, but generous to those who feed it.

quotes.name: Simic Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

quotes.name: Kindly Ancestor // Ancestor's Embrace
quotes.flavor: "Thank you, Grandmother. I love you too."

quotes.name: Prized Amalgam
quotes.flavor:
"Ludevic's laboratory is a veritable wonderland. I have never felt so inspired."
—Stitcher Geralf

quotes.name: Quirion Dryad
quotes.flavor:
"Never underestimate the ability of natural forces to adapt to unnatural influences."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

quotes.name: Squirrel Wrangler
quotes.flavor: "Gnawed to death. Bad way to go."

quotes.name: Silverchase Fox
quotes.flavor:
"Be careful in your hunt. The clever little creature can steal your wards and lead you right into the werewolf's den."
—Britta, midwife of Gatstaf

quotes.name: Summoned Dromedary
quotes.flavor: The camel had traveled this route so often in life that its spirit began moving as soon as the mage finished the summoning.

quotes.name: Kill-Zone Acrobat
quotes.flavor: Her circus training proved surprisingly valuable on the battlefield.

quotes.name: Loran of the Third Path
quotes.flavor: As a scholar, she saw the sylex not as a weapon, but as a key to the past.

quotes.name: Quirion Ranger
quotes.flavor:
"Respect the earth, for it will one day be your shield and another day your blanket."
—Liefellen, Quirion exarch

quotes.name: Savage Order
quotes.flavor:
"Well... it's a superpredator."
—Billy Brennan

quotes.name: Lullmage Mentor
quotes.flavor: "Many voices are needed to quiet this land."

quotes.name: Hanabi Blast
quotes.flavor: The most powerful of akki fire spells were developed at the cost of blood, toil, tears, sweat, and usually a nose or two.

quotes.name: Stalwart Pathlighter
quotes.flavor: "Festival's just ahead. You're almost there!"

quotes.name: Mayor of Avabruck // Howlpack Alpha
quotes.flavor: He can deny his true nature for only so long.

quotes.name: Pacifism
quotes.flavor: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

quotes.name: Horizon Drake
quotes.flavor: Using thermal updrafts and gravity currents, drakes eat and sleep in the air. Some never touch the ground from birth until death.

quotes.name: Dread Return
quotes.flavor: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

quotes.name: Rise of the Hobgoblins
quotes.flavor: A river even the merrow dare not cross.

quotes.name: Basilisk Collar
quotes.flavor: During their endless travels, the mages of the Goma Fada caravan have learned ways to harness both life and death.

quotes.name: Nimbleclaw Adept
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Don't worry, I can reach it."

quotes.name: Kor Cartographer
quotes.flavor: Kor have no concept of exploration. They return to homelands forgotten.

quotes.name: Cabal Coffers
quotes.flavor:
"Evil things came forth, and they took Minas Ithil and abode in it, and they made it into a place of dread; it is now called Minas Morgul, the Tower of Sorcery."
—Elrond

quotes.name: Renewed Faith
quotes.flavor: Skepticism fades in the face of the miraculous.

quotes.name: Conquer
quotes.flavor:
"Why do we trade with those despicable elves? You don't live in forests, you burn them!"
—Avram Garrisson, leader of the Knights of Stromgald

quotes.name: Serra Advocate
quotes.flavor: An angel's touch can prepare a soldier for battle more than a thousand military drills.

quotes.name: Priest of Titania
quotes.flavor: Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

quotes.name: Chandra's Ignition
quotes.flavor: In the moment before her execution, she realized what it meant to be a pyromancer, to be alive, to be Chandra.

quotes.name: Seachrome Coast
quotes.flavor: Where indoctrination meets inquiry, currents roil restlessly beneath the surface.

quotes.name: Wasteland
quotes.flavor:
"The land promises nothing and keeps its promise."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Bogardan Rager
quotes.flavor: In the erupting heart of Bogardan, it's hard to tell hurtling volcanic rocks from pouncing volcanic beasts.

quotes.name: Bogslither's Embrace
quotes.flavor: Shadow creatures are untamable forces of nature—chaotic and hungry.

quotes.name: Bitter Revelation
quotes.flavor:
"Here you lie then, Ugin. The corpses of worlds will join you in the tomb."
—Sorin Markov

quotes.name: Body of Research
quotes.flavor: Needledeep had promised that his final project would be his biggest one yet.

quotes.name: Goblin Ski Patrol
quotes.flavor:
"AIIIEEEE!"
—Ib Halfheart, goblin tactician

quotes.name: Bring the Ending
quotes.flavor: Kaya watched in horror as the illusion vanished from her hands. Jace held the real Sylex—and had activated it before phyresis claimed his mind.

quotes.name: Pestermite
quotes.flavor: The fae know when they're not wanted. That's precisely why they show up.

quotes.name: Baithook Angler // Hook-Haunt Drifter
quotes.flavor: Even in death, he casts his lines, forever fishing for reasons long forgotten.

quotes.name: Charnelhoard Wurm
quotes.flavor: Jund's dragons hoard only sangrite crystals. Its wurms aren't so picky.

quotes.name: Prickly Pair
quotes.flavor: They grew together, awoke together, and took up arms together. If they were going to fall, they'd do that together too.

quotes.name: Graven Lore
quotes.flavor: The runes glow beneath the snow, bearing memories of a time when the old gods ruled the realms.

quotes.name: Barrenton Medic
quotes.flavor: His dreams are filled with noxious powders and clinking vials.

quotes.name: Guttersnipe
quotes.flavor: He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.

quotes.name: Nori, Teller of Tales
quotes.flavor:
"If more of us valued food and cheer and song above hoarded gold, it would be a merrier world."
—Thorin

quotes.name: Myr Custodian
quotes.flavor:
"Myr will go where the work is. We always have. We always will."
—Urtet, Remnant of Memnarch

quotes.name: Faerie Noble
quotes.flavor:
"Faeries talk all in riddles and tricky bits, 'cept the Nobles. Now, there's some straight talkers."
—Joskun, An-Havva Constable

quotes.name: Necrogen Censer
quotes.flavor: Moriok necromancers actively spread necrogen, encouraging the transformation from Mirran to nim.

quotes.name: Thought Vessel
quotes.flavor: Black holes condense matter down to an infinitely miniscule size, making them ideal for data storage. Data retrieval, however, is a bit more complicated.

quotes.name: Bootleggers' Stash
quotes.flavor: Labyrinths of tunnels beneath the streets of the Caldaia offer an ample array of discreet routes for enterprising smugglers.

quotes.name: Rorix Bladewing
quotes.flavor: In the smoldering ashes of Shiv, a few dragons strive to rebuild their native land. The rest seek any opportunity to restore the broken pride of their race.

quotes.name: Quintorius, Field Historian
quotes.flavor: "Every life has a story to tell. I won't let them be forgotten."

quotes.name: Get a Leg Up
quotes.flavor: "Apologies for using you like a stepladder. On the other hand, thank you, you're a wonderful stepladder!"

quotes.name: Steward of Valeron
quotes.flavor: Knight-stewards guard the Sun-Dappled Court, a grove of immense, sculptured olive trees that represent Valeron's twelve noble families.

quotes.name: Deadly Dispute
quotes.flavor:
"Ain't you heard a' honor among thieves?"
—Tombstone, to Anaconda

quotes.name: Yasharn, Implacable Earth
quotes.flavor: In its hoofprints, barren dust becomes fertile ground.

quotes.name: Fervent Charge
quotes.flavor: NCR's rangers were feared far and wide. Even Caesar's Legion respected them in single combat.

quotes.name: Rusted Relic
quotes.flavor:
"We consider rust a curable disease."
—Tarrin, Hammer-Tribe shaman

quotes.name: Malcolm, the Eyes
quotes.flavor: "It's funny how rarely folks here think to look up."

quotes.name: Orcish Librarian
quotes.flavor: "Us hungry, need food . . . . Lots of books . . . . Hmm . . . ."

quotes.name: Panharmonicon
quotes.flavor: All who listen hear their own song, a unique melody played just for them.

quotes.name: Tournament Grounds
quotes.flavor: No one knows when the tournament began. All they know is that it will never end.

quotes.name: Forest
quotes.flavor: You know that hiexel bark produces a lot of smoke when burned, but why would Rilsa Rael need so much of it?

quotes.name: Terashi's Cry
quotes.flavor:
"The sun kami is terrible to behold. When its temper flares, best seek shade and pray for forgiveness."
—Sensei Golden-Tail

quotes.name: Vizier of the Scorpion
quotes.flavor: His blessing is a curse.

quotes.name: Lightning-Rig Crew
quotes.flavor: A pirate ship in battle is a storm of activity.

quotes.name: Golgari Keyrune
quotes.flavor: Like a single ant, it only hints at the colony below.

quotes.name: Mana Leak
quotes.flavor: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

quotes.name: Reckless Blaze
quotes.flavor: Aang learned the hard way not to play with fire.

quotes.name: Vernal Bloom
quotes.flavor: Spring breathes the magic of new life.

quotes.name: Aetherize
quotes.flavor: . . . you won't just be gone, you'll be forgotten . . .

quotes.name: Arc Reactor
quotes.flavor: "I should have died all those years ago, and a dozen times since. I've kept myself alive with my inventions. And I must make good use of this borrowed time."

quotes.name: Foundry Street Denizen
quotes.flavor: After the Foundry Street riot, Arrester Hulbein tried to ban bludgeons. Which, inevitably, resulted in another riot.

quotes.name: Aurelia, the Warleader
quotes.flavor: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

quotes.name: Rhino, Terrible Trampler
quotes.flavor: "Gettin' in and gettin' out ain't a problem. You want the place to stay standing? No promises there."

quotes.name: Arena Athlete
quotes.flavor: The Iroan Games award no medals. Athletes vie for a visit from Iroas, god of victory.

quotes.name: Pillage
quotes.flavor:
"Were they to reduce us to ash, we would clog their throats and sting their eyes in payment."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

quotes.name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
quotes.flavor: Consuming even a single drop of the oil would spell doom for most living things. But Yargle was not most living things, and he ate enough to clean up most of Urborg.

quotes.name: Knight of the Keep
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Now the cries of clear strong voices came ringing over the fields. They rode in: a long line of mail-clad Men, swift, shining, fell and fair to look upon. Suddenly they swept up with a noise like thunder, and the foremost horseman swerved.

quotes.name: Burning Hands
quotes.flavor: A simple fire spell that grows in intensity along with its caster.

quotes.name: Alchemist's Retrieval
quotes.flavor: To most, a terrifying apparition. To a necro-alchemist, a potent fuel source.

quotes.name: Foe-liage
quotes.flavor:
"Wilcox said a weed is but an unloved flower, but this is the kind of flower only his mother could love!"
—Donatello

quotes.name: Clachan Festival
quotes.flavor: Unmatched in their harmony, the troupe took home the festival's trophy with a stirring rendition of "Dundoolin Downs."

quotes.name: Jem Lightfoote, Sky Explorer
quotes.flavor: The nomadic Atiin rarely settle anywhere for more than a few seasons, but Jem never lets that stop her from seeing every last corner.

quotes.name: Dawnwing Marshal
quotes.flavor: "Horizon to horizon, mountain to sea. Everything within is ours to protect."

quotes.name: Shineshadow Snarl
quotes.flavor: A flickering beacon of righteous corruption.

quotes.name: Browse
quotes.flavor:
"Once great literature—now great litter."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

quotes.name: Ambassador Oak
quotes.flavor: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.

quotes.name: Bound in Silence
quotes.flavor: A fight put off forever is already won.

quotes.name: Too Greedily, Too Deep
quotes.flavor:
"The Dwarves tell no tale; but even as mithril was the foundation of their wealth, so also it was their destruction."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Thornwood Falls
quotes.flavor: The Indigo Revolution ousted the Consulate once and for all. Now the citizens of Avishkar cheer for the Aether Rangers as they try to bring victory and glory to their new nation.

quotes.name: Harrow
quotes.flavor: Changing Rath's landscape is like tearing the scab from a wound.

quotes.name: Altar of the Goyf
quotes.flavor:
"What dies grows the [illegible]"
—Clawed-out statue inscription

quotes.name: Backstreet Bruiser
quotes.flavor: "I could show you what's in the case, but it'd be the last thing you ever see."

quotes.name: Foul Imp
quotes.flavor: The imp, unaware of its own odor, paused to catch its breath . . . and promptly died.

quotes.name: No Way Out
quotes.flavor: In the maze-like passages of the Erdwal, a wrong turn can be fatal.

quotes.name: Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin
quotes.set_name: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quotes.flavor: Stranded on New Capenna without a spark, he faced five families out for blood.

quotes.name: Talisman of Progress
quotes.flavor: More sensation than science, these medical magazines only encouraged malpractice.

quotes.name: Quicksilver Wall
quotes.flavor: "Ogg hit wall. Ogg no kill wall. Ogg hate wall!"

quotes.name: Liability
quotes.flavor: Gerrard realized that the helpless woman they'd rescued from Rath was nothing of the sort.

quotes.name: Steel Overseer
quotes.flavor: "Welcome, Administrator. Targeting Parameters have been erased and set to ADMIN_USER_GROUP• <Token. Name=Faction>."

quotes.name: Simic Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

quotes.name: Aftermath Analyst
quotes.flavor: "Could someone bring me more evidence markers? Like...a lot more?"

quotes.name: Escape Tunnel
quotes.flavor: No self-respecting criminal has a basement with only one exit.

quotes.name: Cinder Glade
quotes.flavor: All orbital bombardment did was till the soil.

quotes.name: Dimir Cluestone
quotes.flavor: It waits in the chill of the undercity, holding nameless secrets for those who dare to touch it.

quotes.name: Mystic Genesis
quotes.flavor:
"The Simic can grow anything out of a puddle of sludge. I just hope they never join forces with the Golgari."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

quotes.name: Jet, Rebel Leader
quotes.flavor: "Gotta be quicker next time."

quotes.name: Overtaker
quotes.flavor: "It's no challenge to master a Mercadian."

quotes.name: Poppet Stitcher // Poppet Factory
quotes.flavor: It may have been a mistake to give them minds of their own.

quotes.name: Ring of Renewal
quotes.flavor: To the uninitiated, the Ring of Renewal is merely an oddity. For those fluent in the wielding of magic, however, it is a source of great knowledge.

quotes.name: Immolating Souleater
quotes.flavor:
"We thank the souleaters for melting the sinful that we may be reminded of our own insignificance."
—Drones' hymn of gratitude

quotes.name: Marchesa, Dealer of Death
quotes.flavor: "You should have folded when you had the chance."

quotes.name: Lena, Selfless Champion
quotes.flavor: "Those who do evil and those who do nothing are equally worthy of contempt."

quotes.name: Choked Estuary
quotes.flavor:
"You traveled five miles in twelve years?!"
—The Tenth Doctor

quotes.name: Kozilek, the Great Distortion
quotes.flavor: A void as cryptic as reality itself.

quotes.name: Mindswipe
quotes.flavor:
"The past and the unwritten are frozen. To understand their meaning requires heat."
—Arel the Whisperer

quotes.name: Knollspine Dragon
quotes.flavor: Of the seven Rings of Power the Dwarf-kings possessed, three Sauron has recovered, and the others the dragons have consumed.

quotes.name: Ankle Shanker
quotes.flavor: The stature of the fighter matters less than the depth of the cut.

quotes.name: Dwarven Bloodboiler
quotes.flavor: His battle cry unleashes an avalanche of dwarves.

quotes.name: Makeshift Munitions
quotes.flavor: "Grease up a firecannon good and proper with dinosaur-liver oil, and it'll shoot just about anything."

quotes.name: High Fae Trickster
quotes.flavor: "You humans think even slower than you move. You don't realize you've already lost."

quotes.name: Devastating Summons
quotes.flavor: Things born in magma are always angry.

quotes.name: Bleed Dry
quotes.flavor:
"Wipe your chin, child. We can't have Olivia thinking we're uncivilized."
—Anje Falkenrath

quotes.name: Volatile Wanderglyph
quotes.flavor: Touched eons ago by Ojer Axonil's flaming macuahuitl, it still burns with his boundless fury.

quotes.name: Armored Cancrix
quotes.flavor: Creatures displaced from time still turn up every year, stranded by the temporal disaster that once swept across Dominaria.

quotes.name: Elvish Pioneer
quotes.flavor: "Destruction is the work of an afternoon. Creation is the work of a lifetime."

quotes.name: Puppeteer
quotes.flavor: "Getting people to do what you want is merely a matter of telling them what they want to hear."

quotes.name: Carven Caryatid
quotes.flavor: So-called "old wood" is rare in deforested Ravnica. Statues carved from it are said to house the last of the ancient nature spirits.

quotes.name: Imperious Perfect
quotes.flavor: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

quotes.name: Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit
quotes.flavor: "Help! There's been a horrible murder!"

quotes.name: Death Baron
quotes.flavor: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

quotes.name: Teleportation Circle
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor:
"Hold on to your lunch!"
—Bartleby, gnome wizard

quotes.name: Springbloom Druid
quotes.flavor: "New growth applies a healing poultice to wounds long scabbed over."

quotes.name: Muraganda Raceway
quotes.flavor: Stage 3: The steaming jungles of Muraganda under falling skies.

quotes.name: Mad Auntie
quotes.flavor: One part cunning, one part wise, and many, many parts demented.

quotes.name: Jennika's Technique
quotes.flavor: "Of course it's dangerous. That's the whole point of a weapon!"

quotes.name: Mana Confluence
quotes.flavor: Five rivers encircle Theros, flowing with waters more ancient than the world itself.

quotes.name: Ajani's Pridemate
quotes.flavor:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

quotes.name: Braids, Conjurer Adept
quotes.flavor: The rifted multiverse became a sea of conflicting realities, each peopled by possible versions of every living being.

quotes.name: Culvert Ambusher
quotes.flavor: The bite at the end of the tunnel.

quotes.name: Enrage
quotes.flavor: The barbarians call it "touching the soul of the dragon."

quotes.name: Angel of the Ruins
quotes.flavor:
"I always wanted to visit the Statue of Liberty. I guess she got impatient."
—Rory Williams

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

quotes.name: Iron-Shield Elf
quotes.flavor: Flamekin metalcraft saves many an elvish life but mortally wounds their pride.

quotes.name: Clot Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"One would think I would be accustomed to unexpected returns."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Krovikan Mist
quotes.flavor: Plague-induced dreams became real as they swirled above Krov, mingling with the magical residue of the World Spell.

quotes.name: Fae Offering
quotes.flavor:
"Beware the gift when you do not know the giver."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales

quotes.name: Xorn
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: Xorns are native to the Elemental Plane of Earth, where gems and rare stones are plentiful. When summoned elsewhere they can be quite destructive in search of food.

quotes.name: Voracious Null
quotes.flavor:
"These days, there's no shortage of food for the nulls of Guul Draz."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

quotes.name: Woodland Liege
quotes.flavor: "Your human laws mean nothing here. Plead your case before the tribunal of the wilds."

quotes.name: Sign in Blood
quotes.flavor: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

quotes.name: Cait Sith, Fortune Teller
quotes.flavor: "I'm friend to one and all, thanks to my crystal ball!"

quotes.name: Ivory Crane Netsuke
quotes.flavor: It is said that the feathers of a crane are clouds, plucked and sewn together by the hands of the kami.

quotes.name: Goblin Furrier
quotes.flavor: Clambering up and over the powdery slope, the goblin chanced upon a small furry thing. There they regarded each other: the goblin and his new pair of earmuffs.

quotes.name: Animating Faerie // Bring to Life
quotes.flavor: A true puppet master has no need for strings.

quotes.name: Psionic Sliver
quotes.flavor: They evolved the ability to concentrate their neural activity into a single pulse, causing a disruptive but usually suicidal blast of psionic energy.

quotes.name: Diabolic Edict
quotes.flavor: Greven *il*-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet. "The fall will give you time to think on your failure."

quotes.name: Fendeep Summoner
quotes.flavor: "What is drowned is not forgotten. I will fulfill my oath. Come back to me, my brethren, as I have come back for you."

quotes.name: Archetype of Endurance
quotes.flavor: Despite its fearsome stature, it is as elusive as a shadow, circling round to stalk those who presume to hunt it.

quotes.name: Embodiment of Spring
quotes.flavor: Arel dreamed of winter's end. The next morning she followed a strange trail and found a seedling in the snow.

quotes.name: Suntouched Myr
quotes.flavor: As the fifth sun joins the other four, new abilities awaken in the creatures of Mirrodin.

quotes.name: Familiar Ground
quotes.flavor: More than any other battlefield, the forest gives the advantage to those who know it best.

quotes.name: Path of Peril
quotes.flavor: To Olivia's guests, a welcome. To everyone else, a warning.

quotes.name: Mangara of Corondor
quotes.flavor: "I have been brought to this place and I cannot leave. I may be free of the amber, but I am still in prison."

quotes.name: Zhalfirin Shapecraft
quotes.flavor: Patient and observant, the people of Zhalfir lurked beyond the veil of time until their moment came to finally strike at Phyrexia.

quotes.name: Vraska Joins Up
quotes.flavor: Letting Oko believe he held all the cards provided the perfect cover for her own scheme to unfold.

quotes.name: Despotic Scepter
quotes.flavor:
"We were not meant to have such terrible things. They should be left where we found them, if not destroyed!"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic

quotes.name: Sanguine Evangelist
quotes.flavor: "Fang-brethren, we feed together."

quotes.name: Dragon Egg
quotes.flavor: Dragon birth lairs are littered with treasure to entice the young from their eggs.

quotes.name: Oust
quotes.flavor:
"'Invincible' is just a word."
—Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Treasure Hunter
quotes.flavor:
"What separates junk from treasure is imagination."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Homing Lightning
quotes.flavor:
"I see countless worlds. What makes them think I can't find them in just one?"
—Ral Zarek

quotes.name: Chainer's Edict
quotes.flavor: The pits have their own form of mercy.

quotes.name: Canopy Vista
quotes.flavor: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

quotes.name: Slitherwisp
quotes.flavor: Fear is its habitat, sanity its prey.

quotes.name: Fling
quotes.flavor: Sometimes the cannoneer must become the cannonball.

quotes.name: Unyaro Bee Sting
quotes.flavor:
"Much can be learned from the bees about dying for a cause."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

quotes.name: Fear
quotes.flavor:
"Even the bravest of warriors yet knows the dark clutch of fright upon his stalwart heart."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Snare Thopter
quotes.flavor:
"I did not think I would understand the cold filigree creatures of this world, but they too are governed by the laws of nature."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Captain of Umbar
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"There is a great fleet drawing near to the mouths of Anduin, manned by the Corsairs of Umbar in the South. They have long ceased to fear the might of Gondor."
—Beregond

quotes.name: Caltrops
quotes.flavor: Toward the end, Gatha struggled to keep his experiments in and his patrons out.

quotes.name: Dimir Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"Every guild dreads infiltration. I should know—I've been a member of all of them."
—Lazav

quotes.name: Delusions of Mediocrity
quotes.flavor: When nothing but second best will do.

quotes.name: Vastwood Gorger
quotes.flavor:
"I've known true ferocity and power. Those brazen 'planar-walkers' have no idea what wild really means."
—Chadir the Navigator

quotes.name: Feed the Swarm
quotes.flavor:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

quotes.name: Jade-Cast Sentinel
quotes.flavor: Set in motion by artificers long forgotten, it remained loyal through the ages to the occupants of Kheru City.

quotes.name: Karakas
quotes.flavor:
"I stand in the place of the Steward of Gondor, and it is mine to think first of its people. Gondor must be protected."
—Prince Imrahil

quotes.name: Raging Goblin
quotes.flavor: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

quotes.name: Strategic Betrayal
quotes.flavor: As Sultai blades threatened Qatros city walls, Mehtma of House Fenzala turned her weapons on her political rivals.

quotes.name: Khalni Ambush // Khalni Territory
quotes.flavor:
"The difference between life and death in Ora Ondar is about three seconds of startled screaming."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

quotes.name: Aether Charge
quotes.flavor: "Is it just me, or does that meteor have teeth?"

quotes.name: A.I.M. Bot
quotes.flavor: "Thank you for visiting the Advanced Idea Mechanics laboratory. You will now be eradicated. Goodbye!"

quotes.name: Sauron's Ransom
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "He was dear to you, I see. And now he shall endure the slow torment of years."

quotes.name: Exquisite Blood
quotes.flavor: Even as humans regained the upper hand, some still willingly traded their lives for a chance at immortality.

quotes.name: Stonerise Spirit
quotes.flavor: The carved cliffs of Pillardrop thrum with the sounds of ancient spirits rising from the past.

quotes.name: Prophetic Prism
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: To understand Baldur's Gate, one must first understand how wealth and commerce shape every facet of life.

quotes.name: Insolence
quotes.flavor:
"Sacrificing mortal dragons to satisfy your immortal hunger ends here."
—Darigaaz, to Rith

quotes.name: Deflecting Swat
quotes.flavor: "Oh, what a lovely gift—fire is my favorite!"

quotes.name: Collateral Damage
quotes.flavor: It is much easier to create fire than to contain it.

quotes.name: Rivalry
quotes.flavor: The goblins revered it; the viashino defended it. Only Urza understood it.

quotes.name: Dauthi Trapper
quotes.flavor: Merfolk tell their young of Dandân, humans of Rag Man. Dal tell tales of the Dauthi, and they are far worse.

quotes.name: Goblin Goon
quotes.flavor: Giant-sized body. Goblin-sized brain.

quotes.name: Prowling Nightstalker
quotes.flavor: Silent as a serpent, twisted as a lone bog tree, evil as Tojira's heart.

quotes.name: Gerrard, Weatherlight Hero
quotes.flavor: The heir to the Legacy has finally returned to the *Weatherlight*.

quotes.name: Wrap in Vigor
quotes.flavor: Some nature mages unknowingly took advantage of the temporal energies still swirling on Dominaria. What they mistook for healing magic was in fact the manipulation of time.

quotes.name: Mana Geode
quotes.flavor:
"I don't care if it's an all-powerful relic or a street vendor's lucky charm. If it brings you courage, wear it."
—Saheeli Rai

quotes.name: Withered Wretch
quotes.flavor: Once it consecrated the dead. Now it desecrates them.

quotes.name: Always Watching
quotes.flavor:
"We pray to Avacyn on high. On snow-white wings fearless you fly. Keep safe our souls. Keep safe our lives. May angels watch us from the skies."
—Children's prayer

quotes.name: Alley Evasion
quotes.flavor: "Sure, you know the law. But I know the streets."

quotes.name: Rampaging Cyclops
quotes.flavor: Keldon warriors take advantage of the cyclops's inability to focus on more than one thing at a time.

quotes.name: Necrotic Sliver
quotes.flavor: Though Volrath is long dead, the slivers have become everything he wanted them to be: mindless instruments of destruction and despair.

quotes.name: Mystic Snake
quotes.flavor: Its fangs are in your flesh before its hiss leaves your ears.

quotes.name: Mirkwood Elk
quotes.flavor:
"Whereas the light perceives the very heart of the darkness, its own secret has not been discovered."
—Haldir

quotes.name: Wood Elves
quotes.flavor: Secure in the embrace of wood, they want no part of Eladamri's war.

quotes.name: Crowned Ceratok
quotes.flavor: The best way to calm a rampaging ceratok is to wait until it dies of natural causes.

quotes.name: She-Hulk, Wallbreaker
quotes.flavor: "Knock knock!"

quotes.name: Furnace Celebration
quotes.flavor: Nothing impresses goblins more than something that's bound to kill them.

quotes.name: Map the Frontier
quotes.flavor: Pioneers with a distaste for crowds and cities are welcomed by the Outcasters, who celebrate solitude and find endless wonder in the natural world.

quotes.name: Phyrexian War Beast
quotes.flavor:
"Deal with the spawn of Phyrexia cautiously; only with time may we control them."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Epic Proportions
quotes.flavor: From mite to mighty.

quotes.name: Kethis, the Hidden Hand
quotes.flavor: "The pen is mightier than the crown."

quotes.name: Patron of the Valiant
quotes.flavor: "Bant's most gallant knights wear my sigil, and for that I am humbled."

quotes.name: Venom
quotes.flavor:
"I told him it was just a flesh wound, but the next time I looked at him, poor Tadhg was dead and gone."
—Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

quotes.name: Selfless Police Captain
quotes.flavor:
"Peter always disappears when Spider-Man is around. How very odd."
—Captain George Stacy

quotes.name: Utvara Hellkite
quotes.flavor: The fear of dragons is as old and as powerful as the fear of death itself.

quotes.name: Apex of Power
quotes.flavor:
"As I desire, so it shall be."
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Doc Ock's Tentacles
quotes.flavor: Once powerful tools of science, Dr. Otto Octavius's mechanical arms became his most formidable weapons.

quotes.name: Lindblum, Industrial Regency // Mage Siege
quotes.flavor: A city encircled by the ramparts of a massive castle.

quotes.name: Yotian Soldier
quotes.flavor: Poets dream the verses of otherworldly stories. Artificers dream the blueprints of otherplanar artifacts.

quotes.name: Orcish Veteran
quotes.flavor:
"Orcs often greeted promotions to Icatian battle with anguished wails and pleas for mercy."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

quotes.name: Armaggon, Future Shark
quotes.flavor: "I am ancient efficiency. I am evolution's future. I am mutation come full, vicious circle!"

quotes.name: Rainbow Efreet
quotes.flavor:
"A beauty made more so by its fleeting visitations."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Sardian Cliffstomper
quotes.flavor: When Urza betrayed the Sardian dwarves, they called upon the might of their neighbors for aid.

quotes.name: Thunderwolf Cavalry
quotes.flavor: The practice of tracking and training Thunderwolves is a sort of initiation ritual into the upper echelons of the Wolf Guard.

quotes.name: Grey Knight Paragon
quotes.flavor:
"Our will shall be our weapons, our faith shall be our armour."
—Canticle of Absolution

quotes.name: Scavenged Weaponry
quotes.flavor: "The Phyrexians have progressed," admired Urza. "Their parts are interchangeable."

quotes.name: Pore Over the Pages
quotes.flavor: "'I'm certain that the fate of Markov Manor is connected to these cryptoliths . . .' This Tamiyo was on to something."

quotes.name: Brawn
quotes.flavor:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Bayek of Siwa
quotes.flavor: "Our will never rests . . ."

quotes.name: Falcon Abomination
quotes.flavor: The foulest of fowl.

quotes.name: Humble Defector
quotes.flavor:
"You were once Mardu, so your body and will are strong. Now we must train your mind."
—Houn, Jeskai elder

quotes.name: Nantuko Cultivator
quotes.flavor: "Every seed holds strength and teaches patience."

quotes.name: Phantom Beast
quotes.flavor: As insubstantial as fear, and as dangerous.

quotes.name: Selesnya Sentry
quotes.flavor: Ravnicans still tell tales about the Battle of Sumala where four Selesnya sentries held off an entire clan of Gruul warriors.

quotes.name: Shamanic Revelation
quotes.flavor: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

quotes.name: Thriving Grove
quotes.flavor: A place of perfect calm in a raging world.

quotes.name: Krosan Grip
quotes.flavor:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

quotes.name: Ingot Chewer
quotes.flavor: Elementals are ideas given form. This one is the idea of "smashitude."

quotes.name: Qasali Pridemage
quotes.flavor: An elder in one pride, of the Sigiled caste in another.

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

quotes.name: Codecracker Hound
quotes.flavor: Even across the Edge, a dog is still a dog.

quotes.name: Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore
quotes.flavor:
"Past and possibility come together in the vastness of infinite reflection."
—Ashen Wal, Akoum Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Hellkite Igniter
quotes.flavor: Its flight sets the sky itself on fire.

quotes.name: Knight of Stromgald
quotes.flavor:
"Kjeldorans should rule supreme, and to the rest, death!"
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald
